content_sections.heading: SVBPH Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the SVBPH Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download SVBPH Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: SVBPH Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: MBBS with Post Graduate Degree/ DNB/ Diploma as per residency scheme in the concerned specialty from a recognized University/ Institution.

content_sections.heading: SVBPH Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 45 years Age Relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Senior Resident posts at SVBPH?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Senior Resident posts at Sardar Vallabh Bhai Patel Hospital Delhi is scheduled for 23rd September 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Resident position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies for the Senior Resident posts at Sardar Vallabh Bhai Patel Hospital Delhi. These vacancies are distributed across different specialties.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification for the Senior Resident posts is MBBS with a Post Graduate Degree/ DNB/ Diploma in the concerned specialty from a recognized University/ Institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Resident posts is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST and OBC categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Senior Resident posts will receive a salary of Rs. 67700 Per Month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the SVBPH Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for the Senior Resident posts at SVBPH for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Resident posts at SVBPH will involve a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview for SVBPH Senior Resident posts being held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Sardar Vallabh Bhai Patel Hospital Delhi. The exact address and reporting time will be mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or ad-hoc position?
faq.answer: The Senior Resident positions at Sardar Vallabh Bhai Patel Hospital Delhi are on an ad-hoc basis.
